WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN riskandmargin AS r
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count
  FROM counts
)
SELECT AVG(c.order_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(c.order_count - a.avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM counts AS c
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE c.order_count > a.avg_count;
